info.title: Meziantou.Framework.Language.Tool
info.description: CLI to dump CSS, INI, JSON, TOML, XML, regular expression, and shell syntax trees as JSON

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Inspect CSS, INI, JSON, TOML, XML, regular expression, and shell documents

commands.name: syntax
commands.description: Dump the syntax tree of a CSS, INI, JSON, TOML, XML, regular expression, or shell document as JSON

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to the file to parse. If omitted, reads from stdin

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the JSON file to write. If omitted, writes to stdout

options.name: --language
options.description: Language to parse the input as. If omitted, it is detected from the extension of --input, which is why it is required when reading from stdin. One of: css, ini, json, toml, xml, regex, regex-dotnet, regex-javascript, regex-pcre, regex-ere, regex-bre, sh, bash, zsh, powershell, pwsh, cmd

options.name: --no-tokens
options.description: Omit the tokens of each node, and the trivia they carry

options.name: --no-trivia
options.description: Omit the leading and trailing trivia of each token

options.name: --no-text
options.description: Omit the source text of each node, token, and trivia

options.name: --no-spans
options.description: Omit the source spans of each node, token, and trivia
